title: Men's Crofter Slipper
description:
Like the Original, the Crofter Slipper offers the comfort of pure wool and sheepskin with the durability of natural leather. It also has a taller cuff that covers the ankle for extra warmth and a thick lace keeps the slipper snug on the foot.

Please note, due to its limited production the Crofter is only available on our website.  Also, as our wool is hand dyed in small batches there will be some variation in the colours from the image shown

title: Women's Crofter Slipper
description:
The women's Crofter Slipper is made from fine New Zealand wool, natural leather and a luxurious sheepskin lining. What makes the Crofter special is the taller opening cuff, which covers the ankle for even more warm and comfort while it's still easy to slip on your foot.

Please note, due to its limited production the Crofter is only available on our website. Also, as our wool is hand dyed in small batches there will be some variation in the colours from the image shown.

title: Youth Slipper
description: With a variety of fun colours to choose from, these slippers are perfect for independent grade-schoolers who want to add a pop of personality to their outfit. Cozy and warm, they provide a comforting escape from the hustle and bustle of school and play. Treat your child to the ultimate comfort with our stylish and practical sheepskin and wool slippers.

title: Women's Original Slipper
description: Indulge in the ultimate cozy experience with our Women's Original Slippers. Expertly crafted by hand, these slippers are made from premium New Zealand wool and lined with plush sheepskin for unparalleled comfort. Perfect for all seasons, the wool fibres naturally breathe and promote healthy feet. So treat your feet to the ultimate in luxury and comfort with our Women's Original Slippers.

title: Baby Slippers
description: Pamper your baby's feet with our delightful hand-crocheted slippers. Crafted from premium New Zealand wool and luxurious sheepskin, they offer a cozy fit in a range of eye-catching hues and undyed neutral tones. The adjustable ankle tie ensures a snug, secure fit for even the most active toddlers, while allowing feet to grow and move freely. Keep little toes toasty and content with these unique slippers.

title: Child Slipper
description: Discover the perfect footwear for adventurous kids with our colourful wool slippers. Whether exploring the world around them or engaging their active imaginations, these slippers will keep up with every step of their journey. Our New Zealand wool feels great against their skin, while the durable leather outsoles will endure their endless excitement. Easy for little hands to pull on, these slippers will add a pop of personality and style to any outfit, making them the ideal choice for young explorers.

title: Men's Original Slipper
description: Wearing our men’s original slippers makes every day feel like a day at the cabin. Perfect for lazy weekends at home, these slippers are expertly crafted to deliver exceptional comfort and durability. The uppers are made from fine New Zealand wool, while the liners are made from plush sheepskin and the leather soles add an extra layer of durability, ensuring that these slippers will last for years to come. So kick back, relax, and treat your feet to the ultimate in comfort with our Men's Original Slippers.

title: Newborn Slipper
description: Present a one-of-a-kind keepsake with our darling Newborn Slippers. Expertly handcrafted from 100% sheeps wool, they coddle sensitive skin and make a cherished memento. Perfect for friends or grandparents looking for a precious gift, these slippers are available in a range of colours and are sure to bring joy to new parents.
